text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day?
—Me, to Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: There's plenty of folks at our academy who'd give them out. Once you debut, you rely on them practically as much as your own parents. It's the perfect occasion to show your gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's you, it wouldn't be strange to have
a piece of chocolate or two prepared, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing the slightly testing gaze...
Sirius Symboli scoffed with amusement.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I wondered what came over you so suddenly, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you placed a bet, you've already lost.
I haven't prepared a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm not in the business of flattering anyone.
Though you probably already know that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But you still look up to those trainers from your childhood, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I figured she was the type to show a decent amount of respect to a coach, but――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, she's different from the old man and the others, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...In every sense, that's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Timid and a worrywart.
With claws and fangs dulled, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
............
――"Operation Summer Sirius."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ha, that name is so lame.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...The only thing sharp about you is your nose.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? 
So that's what you meant by "different."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?
Are you stupid? Don't say such creepy things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day.
All across the academy, I saw people exchanging gifts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not uncommon for Trainers to receive gifts
from their trainees out of everyday appreciation, but—
choice_data_list: (I doubt I'll hear from Sirius Symboli...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I almost feel like
we ought to be the ones providing it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I'll swing by the department store on the way home." Lost in that thought, I entered the Trainer's office, and—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yo.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Don't drop it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she tossed something over to me.
I scrambled to catch it, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a café latte from a brand I'd never seen before.
Could the product name be in French...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You've been working reasonably hard, after all.
It's an occasional treat.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What else could there be?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you'd prefer a punishment over a reward,
I wouldn't mind switching it up for ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone reached for it, she hastily hid it behind her back.
...She never imagined she'd actually receive it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If you were gonna wag your tail anyway, you should've done it from the start.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Do that, and I'll give it to you again next year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind the words “Don't tell Nakayama,”
Sirius Symboli headed back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cafe latte was bittersweet—
and just a tiny bit sweet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I could ask what she needed, she briskly walked right up in front of me. And thenâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A long leg kicks out against the wall right beside me—
forcibly trapping me between her and the wall.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Open your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what was happening,
but unable to resist her commanding gaze,
I obediently opened my mouth. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A single sweet morsel popped right into my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, good girl.
...Savor it, all right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's a masterpiece from a Parisian caramel artisan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As you chew it...
you realize that it is indeed caramel.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I had no intention of preparing one. But... I changed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Most of the time you're just a hopeless
little puppy, but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What's here is... extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli tapped me lightly
right on the center of my chest.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll expect great things from you.
Keep wagging your tail and following right behind me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Leaving a whisper behind, she walks away.
The sweet lingering sensation didn't fade for some time.
